title: WorkspaceInspection

path.description: The path as a directory request records it: ~ expanded, . and .. resolved, symlinks kept.

anyOf.description: Why a directory cannot be a session's workspace: does_not_exist, not_a_directory, not_readable (the environment's user cannot list or enter it), or reserved (inside the environment's data directory, outside every workspace root).

problem.description: Why a directory request for the path would be refused workspace_unusable; null when a session could work there.

root.description: The top of the worktree holding the path; for a path in no worktree (a bare repository), the repository's own directory.

mainCheckout.description: The main checkout, or the bare repository: what a worktree is made from.

bare.description: True for a bare repository, which has no checkout of its own.

repositoryIdentity.description: The repository identity a session working at the path would get, by the rule sessions.create applies; null when its remote gives none.

branch.description: The branch checked out at the path, without refs/heads/; null when HEAD is detached.

commit.description: A git commit's full object name: 40 lowercase hexadecimal digits, or 64 in a SHA-256 repository.

anyOf.description: A commit and its committer date.

head.description: The commit HEAD is at, and its date; null before the first commit.

originHead.description: The branch origin/HEAD points at, as git last cached it (origin/main); null when none is cached. Nothing is fetched.

commit.description: A git commit's full object name: 40 lowercase hexadecimal digits, or 64 in a SHA-256 repository.

anyOf.description: An absolute path as the environment's operating system writes it: from /, a drive (C:\) or a share (\\).

worktree.description: The worktree the branch is checked out in (the main checkout among them), where a worktree on it cannot be made; null when none holds it.

anyOf.description: A session's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints (never the provider's resume id), kept in lowercase.

sessionId.description: When the harness made that worktree for a session on this environment: the session whose workspace it is; else null.

items.description: A local branch at its latest commit, with the worktree holding it.

branches.description: The local branches, the most recently committed first (by name among equals), at most 200.

branchesTruncated.description: True when the repository has more than the 200 branches listed.

anyOf.description: The repository holding an inspected path, as the worktree step reads it.

repository.description: The git repository holding the path, when a session could work there; null outside any repository, or where the environment has no git.

description: Whether a path would be a usable directory workspace, and the repository holding it.
